name: Bone Devil

actions.name: Scorpion Sting
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned, the target also takes 2d8 poison at the start of each turn.

actions.name: Wall of Ice
actions.effect: Creates a wall of ice up to 18m long and 3m high. Creatures in the wall's path must pass PHYS save or take 4d8 cold damage and be pushed to one side. The wall has 20 HP and provides full cover.

reactions.name: Frightful Presence
reactions.effect: When a creature enters melee range, it must pass WILL save or be frightened for 1 round.

reactions.name: Magic Resistance
reactions.effect: +2d6 to a save against a spell or magical effect.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Can see perfectly in magical and non-magical darkness up to 36m.

traits.name: Infernal Commander
traits.desc: Can command up to 6 lesser devils (Lemures, Imps, Spined Devils, Bearded Devils). These act on the Bone Devil's initiative.

lore: Bone Devils are skeletal, scorpion-tailed fiends that serve as the overseers and commanders of Hell's middle ranks. They enforce infernal law with cold efficiency, punishing failure among lesser devils with swift and terrible retribution.
